core_philosophy.manifesto: TripThread documents trips. The home feed is a list of published final posts that read as trip journals—not Instagram photo squares or a pure text stream. Cards share one shell so a mixed feed still feels like one app. Spend and split never appear on the feed.

titles.usage: Trip titles on cards; section display where needed

body.usage: Names, route line, summary, caption, counts, labels, thread snippets, picker labels

dark.note: Specified for later Flutter build. HTML mockup is light theme only.

map.multi_pin_note: When building later, compose multiple pin-s+1d6fe8 overlays and auto or explicit camera; mockup uses a CSS stand-in when no token is present.
map.on_tap: Navigate to /trip/:tripId/map. Omit the map block entirely when the trip has no coordinates; still show the destination route line.

engagement.bar: Existing EngagementActionBar: outlined heart, comment, share with counts

happening_now_row.label: HAPPENING NOW
happening_now_row.name: First name only (or You for self). Not circles.

shared_card_frame.order_note: Template body owns photo/map placement. Postcard and map-first place title/route/summary inside or under the body as specified per template. Thread-reel places title and one-line summary under the split row.

header.under_name: Trip window from trip.startDate / trip.endDate, e.g. 12–18 Oct · 7 days
header.publish_timestamp: Moved off the header (not shown in this design)
header.right: Owner overflow Edit / Delete when viewer is author

summary.summaryText: Two lines max on postcard and map-first; one line on thread-reel
summary.caption: Shown in stone under summary when present

thread_pager.swipe: Horizontal only so the vertical feed still scrolls
thread_pager.indicators: Dots; active uses accent, inactive uses stone/outline

entry_row.text_only_fallback: Stone place tile instead of photo

postcard.best_for: City and road trips where the photo is the memory and the route is the caption
layout: Cover photo ~220px full width with 8px cream inset; swipe + dots when multiple curated photos
Stamp chip top-right of photo: first destination, or trip mood if no destination — stone outline, slight rotation, ink text (not a red rubber stamp)
Map strip ~88px labeled Route · N places; omit if no coordinates

map_first.best_for: Treks and circuits where the path is the story
layout: Map hero ~220px with route through pins and accent pin color; corner chip Open map
Route line on bottom of map in cream scrim
Curated photos as ~72px filmstrip (no full-bleed carousel)

thread_reel.best_for: Diary trips where the writing matters more than one hero photo
layout: Short split row: left ~42% width × 168px cover photo with N places pill that opens map; right first thread page (two snippets) with 2px accent-blue left bars (no amber)
Title, one-line summary, 1 of N + pager dots; swipe replaces the pair

author_template_picker.ui: Three compact tiles in one row: Postcard, Map, Threads

tile.content: Tiny diagram of that layout + one-line label

author_template_picker.this_pass: Mockup shows the control only. Persisting templateChoice is a later build.

empty_cases.no_photo: Postcard uses cream muted block; thread-reel left column uses stone place tile; map-first filmstrip omitted
empty_cases.no_pins: Omit map block / Open map pill; keep destination route line
empty_cases.single_destination: Route line is just that name

later_build_not_in_this_pass: Home feed payload: short thread preview (id, text, media url, place name, like count, createdAt) + pin coordinates for static map
Server-side sorting and paging of thread preview so the card does not download the whole thread
Flutter widgets for the three templates and picker persistence
GET /api/feed/home and Prisma schema stay untouched in this pass

contains: Happening Now row matching current 64px rounded squares
One postcard, one map-first, one thread-reel card with sample Jaipur road trip, trek, and diary trip
Three-tile picker above a Publish affordance
